given: a SKU holds stock at more than one location
when: the operator opens the detail view for that SKU
then: the view lists one row per location where that SKU holds stock, showing each location and its quantity, and shows only that SKU's records
architectural_notes: Read-through detail exercised at the API boundary (app/routes/, renders_via react): a GET keyed by SKU returns a JSON collection of that SKU's per-location rows. The boundary delegates to the stock service (app/services/), which calls the repository (app/repositories/) for a SKU-scoped SELECT over the stock table; the (sku, location) uniqueness invariant (PI1) guarantees one row per location and the SKU filter is enforced in the repository query, never post-filtered in the view. Cross-cutting: SKU-scoping/isolation is owned in the service+repository query, not the SPA; the React client (client/) renders the returned rows.
